value.rationale: The distribution of the first missing allowed part in a union of congruence classes is a natural partition statistic. Its full vector joint law shows exact limiting asymptotic independence and nontrivial competing-residue uniformity, determining a motivating new companion coefficient asymptotic a_e=b_e~p/3. The distributional result is stronger than single-class moments and provides a structural way to evaluate other union-of-residue missing-part observables.
